## 0.1.1 (2026-10-26)

### Security

- Use Zod 4.6.6 in the SDK bundles. Oversized constrained collections fail
  before their entries are validated. [#348](https://github.com/maelstrom-co/maelstrom/pull/348)

### SDK changes

- Inspect retained planner evidence in DevTools request details.
  [#326](https://github.com/maelstrom-co/maelstrom/pull/326),
  [#327](https://github.com/maelstrom-co/maelstrom/pull/327)
- Explain DevTools setup and missing evidence.
  [c29674e3](https://github.com/maelstrom-co/maelstrom/commit/c29674e3)
- Retain existing tiling instances by default in the LLM planner.
  [#342](https://github.com/maelstrom-co/maelstrom/pull/342)
- Report cached token usage and provider-reported cost when available.
  [#335](https://github.com/maelstrom-co/maelstrom/pull/335)

### Upgrade

Keep all installed `@maelstrom-co/*` packages at 0.1.1.

Planner integrations use TanStack 1.0. Upgrade the core and provider adapters
together. See the [TanStack upgrade guide](https://tanstack.com/ai/latest/docs/migration/v1)
and [#334](https://github.com/maelstrom-co/maelstrom/pull/334).
